name: 4855 College Ave
subtitle: 3.05-Acre Multifamily Development
overline-type: Full Offering Memorandum - presented to industry judges
description: A complete Offering Memorandum for a 3.05-acre site zoned single-family, with a proposed rezone to multifamily from RS-1-7 to RM-4-10. The work packages zoning, demographics, market analysis, development programming, financial modeling, and exit strategy in the same format used by institutional real estate teams. Presented at a UCSD Urban Planning EXPO with a charrette board and investor video pitch.
tags: Offering Memorandum, 3.05 Acres, Multifamily, College Area, Rezone, 10-Yr Proforma, Investor Pitch, CoStar
featured-context: SENIOR CAPSTONE - UCSD URBAN PLANNING EXPO
analysis-design-list-2:
• Land use and zoning analysis for RS-1-7 to RM-4-10 rezone
  • Demographics with growth projections through 2035
  • Market analysis covering vacancy, rents, absorption, and comparable projects
  • Development program, site plan logic, and parking approach
  • Design vision, massing, amenities, and tenant mix
  • Community benefits summary and SWOT analysis
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• 10-year development proforma with full cash flow
  • IRR, cash-on-cash, equity multiple, and levered return outputs
  • Financing assumptions, cost basis, and cap rate sensitivity
  • Marketing and branding identity for investor presentation
  • 30-page investor-ready Offering Memorandum
  • EXPO charrette board and investor video pitch

name: 6966 Amherst St
subtitle: 14-Unit Acquisition
description: Value-add acquisition analysis for a small multifamily asset, including a 10-year operating model, CapEx schedule, rent-renovation assumptions, exit cap sensitivity, and investor return summary. The scenario tests a 6% stabilized cash-on-cash yield, 14% levered return, 12% IRR, and 2.0x equity multiple.
analysis-design-list-2:
• Rent roll review and in-place lease normalization
  • Renovation scope and CapEx timing by unit type
  • Market rent benchmark against nearby College Area assets
  • Exit cap sensitivity and stabilized NOI review
  • Hold-versus-sell recommendation for investor committee
financial-deliverables-list-2:
• 10-year acquisition proforma
  • IRR and NPV return summary
  • CapEx schedule and renovation budget
  • Debt sizing assumptions and DSCR check
  • Investor memo with risk notes

subtitle: Strip Center

  • JV promote and investor hurdle model
  • Lease structure comparison table
  • Stabilized NOI and exit value sensitivity
  • Partner-ready investment summary
